evidence.quote: Tuition fees per semester The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
Tuition fee for international students from outside the EU/EEA 1,500.00 eur

The document recognizing your academic qualifications is a mandatory part of your application. To do so, you must apply to Uni Assist for a preliminary review documentation (Vorprüfungsdokumentation - VPD which assesses your eligibility for university admission in Germany).
These include your entrance qualification, language certificate(s), the VPD-Certificate from uni-assist, passport picture and a passport copy.

notes: The deadline 03.12.2026 is on the programme page and is the application deadline for the summer term 2027; it is not explicitly labelled as only for international applicants but the programme page is for the English-taught programme and the application process for English-taught programmes is for international applicants. The application channel is de-uni-assist-vpd because the page states foreign applicants must obtain a VPD from uni-assist, then apply in the university's own portal. Tuition is per semester; the DAAD page says 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants. The documents list comes from the 1st step of the application tutorial for English-taught programmes; it says 'passport picture and a passport copy' but only the passport copy is listed as a document because the passport picture is not a standard document category. The transcript of records is not listed for this Bachelor's programme.

note.fr: Vérifier les conditions d'admission sur la page du programme : test d'aptitude TestAS ou SAT/ACT, exigences de langue, documents via uni-assist (VPD).
note.en: Check admission requirements on the programme page: aptitude test TestAS or SAT/ACT, language requirements, documents via uni-assist (VPD).
